item.text: This is a very small app. I see pre-existing changes in `package.json` and an untracked lockfile, so I’ll avoid touching dependency metadata unless the code requires it.
I’m going to add a small server-only analytics helper and a Server Component that reads request headers during render, then schedules the analytics call with `after()` so the HTML can be sent first.
The component is in place. I’m checking the build now because `after()` support and async header access are version-sensitive in Next.js.
